From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novaprod.com>

Date: 2026-10-12T15:02:00Z
Subject: Invoice INV-2026-311 — PO number mismatch & tax withholding

Hi Lauren,

We received invoice INV-2026-311 but our AP platform flagged a PO mismatch (our PO is 8891, invoice references 8890). Before we can route this for payment we need either an updated invoice that matches PO 8891 or confirmation that Nova should process against 8890.

Also flagging that this is an EU-to-US transfer and our treasury team is asking whether Redwood requires any local tax withholding documentation (we usually request W-8BEN-E for non-US vendors, but we'd like to confirm). If there are additional tax forms or a UK/EU VAT registration for Redwood, please let me know so we can avoid withholding on our side.

Payment method: our AP prefers ACH within SEPA/BACS equivalents, but we can initiate a same-day wire if needed. Our CC attempt failed earlier this month (card limit), so wire is the likely fallback. Please advise the preferred remittance details and whether you can accept the wire (we will cover bank fees) — timeline: we aim to clear this week if we get the corrected invoice/confirmation.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Accounts Payable
Nova Product Labs

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up.

Short answers up front:
- We will re-issue the invoice to reference PO 8891 today and send PDF by EOD.
- Redwood is a US entity (Redwood Inference, EIN ending **34). We can provide a completed W-9. We do not expect EU VAT registration for this engagement, so withholding shouldn’t be required once W-9 is on file.
- Wire is fine — we can accept wire or ACH depending on what your bank supports. I’ll include our remittance and bank details in the corrected invoice.

Operational ask: if you go with wire, can you confirm who in AP (name/email) will send the transfer so we can match it quickly on our side? If your system requires DocuSign or a specific invoice layout, let us know and I’ll route to Finance.

I’ve CC’d Dev on this to confirm the card/fallback details and Marissa to track collection timing and whether we should mark this as a priority for the month-close. Proposed payment window from our side: receipt of funds by 2026-10-16 to avoid escalation; if you need more time we can agree to Net-7.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop

Lauren / Marissa — quick internal note before we send updated invoice to Nova AP:

- I’ve asked Treasury to pre-authorize matching for PO 8891 once the remittance reference shows INV-2026-311 / Nova PO 8891. That should speed reconciliation.
- If Nova requests an escrow or partial hold for operational reasons, we should decline unless it’s a longer-term contract; for a standard invoice send we’ll accept wire and release access as soon as funds clear.

Putting Net-7 as acceptable if they need extra time — can approve one-time extension for this month.

— Dev
